ONTARIO COURT OF JUSTICE - FAMILY COURT
Court file number: FC-26-0000
APPLICATION (General) - Form 8
Applicant: [name]
Respondent: Joseph Mensah
The applicant asks the court for: decision-making responsibility and parenting time for the children; child support under the Child Support Guidelines.
TO THE RESPONDENT: If you want to oppose any claim in this case, you or your lawyer must prepare an Answer (Form 10), serve a copy on the applicant and file a copy in the court office with an Affidavit of Service, within 30 days after this application is served on you. If you do not, the case will go ahead without you and the court may make an order against you.
Date of service: September 10, 2026
